n35e4c22ee3.headline: UAE-India remittances see steady growth as investment becomes key driver
n35e4c22ee3.summary: Remittances from the UAE to India are growing steadily, with a significant portion now being funnelled into India's stock market, an expert noted.
n35e4c22ee3.why: Remittances are a major source of foreign income for India, and their flow into equities links Gulf worker earnings to Indian capital markets.

nd2fb1ad90e.headline: U.S. tariffs and the strength of aluminum in Arvida
nd2fb1ad90e.summary: Arvida, more than 200 km north of Quebec City, is home to an aluminum bridge built in 1950. The article links U.S. tariffs to the strength of the region's aluminum industry.
nd2fb1ad90e.why: Aluminum is a tariff-sensitive industrial metal, and Canada is a major supplier to the U.S. market, so trade barriers directly affect producer margins and export volumes.

nc6e7216014.headline: U.S. stocks fall again, wiping out earlier gains as Trump tariff shock remains
nc6e7216014.summary: US stocks retreated for another day after attempting a rebound earlier in the session. Trillions of dollars in investor wealth have been wiped out since last week.
nc6e7216014.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the most widely watched benchmark for US equity performance.
nc6e7216014.why_moved: Stocks gave back an earlier rebound as the tariff shock continued to weigh on sentiment, with large losses in investor wealth since the prior week.

nea0bd50140.headline: 'Answer the question!’: Senator berates Trump official over 'ridiculous policy'
nea0bd50140.summary: Senator Mark Warner criticised US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer over sweeping tariff policy, including tariffs on Australia. The article describes the exchange as a sharp challenge to the administration's trade approach.
nea0bd50140.why: The US Trade Representative sets American trade policy, and tariff decisions affect global supply chains and bilateral trade relationships.

n20240091ce.headline: What is a 'Panican'? Donald Trump coins new term as he shrugs off tariffs backlash
n20240091ce.summary: US stock market losses are continuing, according to reports, as President Trump urges Americans not to panic. He has pointed to the tariff policy backlash.
n20240091ce.why: The S&P 500 and other US indexes are the main benchmarks for American equity performance, and tariff uncertainty is a well-known driver of equity volatility.
n20240091ce.why_moved: The article reports ongoing stock market losses across the US amid a backlash over tariffs, which investors see as a source of uncertainty.

nd339bf8d0a.headline: Almost half of Scottish firms
nd339bf8d0a.summary: Almost half of Scotland's mid-market businesses have frozen salaries or stopped pay rises because of Labour's changes to tax and wages, a poll has found.
nd339bf8d0a.why: Employer pay decisions shape wage growth, labour costs and consumer spending, which feed into the UK economic outlook.

n72639ff43b.headline: British stocks notch strongest session since 2022 on hopes for tariff negotiations
n72639ff43b.summary: The FTSE 100 rose 2.7%, its biggest daily jump since March 2022, recovering from its lowest close in over a year as US trade negotiators prioritise allies.
n72639ff43b.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest UK-listed companies, many of which earn significant revenue overseas.

impacts.name: FTSE 100
impacts.why: Hopes for tariff negotiations with US trade partners lifted UK blue-chip stocks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n72639ff43b.why_moved: Hopes for tariff negotiations, with US trade negotiators prioritising allies, drove a sharp rebound from the prior session's lowest close in over a year.

n35627d23bb.headline: Trade war will influence housing market, report says - National News - Roscommon Herald
n35627d23bb.summary: MyHome's latest quarterly house price report, produced with Bank of Ireland, says the threat of a trade war will influence the housing market.
n35627d23bb.why: Housing market conditions affect mortgage lending, construction activity and household wealth in Ireland.

n823152fe9a.headline: BRAZIL - CHINA'S EV BOOM
n823152fe9a.summary: Chinese electric vehicle sales to Latin America are booming, especially in Brazil. China is also investing nearly a billion dollars in an EV plant there, though the article notes some troubles.
n823152fe9a.why: Chinese automakers are expanding rapidly in electric vehicles, reshaping competition in Latin American car markets and local manufacturing.

n56b1feb579.headline: Panama to file charges over alleged sweetheart port contract
n56b1feb579.summary: Panamanian officials say the contract held by Hong Kong-based CK Hutchison Holdings to run two Panama Canal ports cost the nation $1.3 billion. BlackRock is reportedly spearheading a possible deal.
n56b1feb579.why: CK Hutchison is a Hong Kong conglomerate with major global port operations, and Panama Canal port concessions are strategically important for global shipping. Contract disputes can affect port valuations and infrastructure deal flows.

na3cf2f5321.headline: Australian PM Tells Voters He's Ready For Trump Tariffs
na3cf2f5321.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Australia is ready for the impact of US trade tariffs. He spoke in a television debate before the tightly contested May 3 election.
na3cf2f5321.why: Australia is a trade-exposed economy that relies heavily on exports of commodities, so US tariff policy matters for its growth and currency.

n2885edb275.headline: Larry Kudlow Presses Scott Bessent About How Administration Decided Trump Tariff Rates
n2885edb275.summary: Larry Kudlow pressed US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Fox Business on the rationale behind the tariff rates imposed by President Donald Trump.
n2885edb275.why: The US Treasury Secretary is a senior economic official who helps shape the administration's trade and fiscal policy.

nce796d530d.headline: New potential Eurostar rival emerges
nce796d530d.summary: FS Italiane Group said it plans to launch services through the Channel Tunnel by 2029, emerging as a potential rival to Eurostar.
nce796d530d.why: FS Italiane is the holding company of Italy's state railway group, and new cross-Channel services would add competition on the London-Paris-Brussels corridor.

n341761990a.headline: Talks With Trump A Necessity For Sanctions-hit Iran
n341761990a.summary: Trump announced direct talks with Iran over its nuclear programme, a move that appeared to catch Tehran off guard. Iran is under sanctions and has been threatened with bombing.
n341761990a.why: Sanctions limit Iran's oil exports and access to global finance, so any easing or escalation affects energy markets and regional risk. Investors track such diplomacy closely.

n5cd22dbd23.headline: European pharma companies warn Trump
n5cd22dbd23.summary: European pharmaceutical companies warned European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen at a Tuesday meeting that US tariffs would accelerate industry problems. The warning came in Brussels.
n5cd22dbd23.why: Europe's drugmakers sell large volumes into the US, so tariffs on pharmaceutical trade directly affect their revenues and supply chains.

n6a7b3850b1.headline: China vows retaliation and a 'fight to the end' after Trump's latest tariff threat
n6a7b3850b1.summary: China vowed retaliation and a fight to the end after Donald Trump threatened new tariffs unless Beijing retracts its 34% retaliatory tariff on US goods.
n6a7b3850b1.why: The US and China are the world's two largest economies, and escalating tariffs affect global trade flows, corporate margins and supply chains.

naf24281883.headline: Scarce Egg Supply Due to Avian Influenza
naf24281883.summary: Austrian households bought more eggs in 2024 than ever before, according to AMA marketing, surpassing the sales record set at the peak of the coronavirus pandemic, amid scarce supply due to avian influenza.
naf24281883.why: Avian influenza outbreaks reduce poultry flock sizes, which pushes up egg prices and affects food retailers and producers.

n5adc2d8a79.headline: China retaliates with 84% tariffs on US goods as Trump tariffs kick in
n5adc2d8a79.summary: China has imposed 84% tariffs on US goods as new Trump tariffs kick in. The Business Times reports the EU is set to begin retaliating against US tariffs the following week.
n5adc2d8a79.why: US tariffs and retaliatory duties disrupt global trade flows, affecting supply chains, export earnings and corporate margins across multiple economies.
n5adc2d8a79.why_moved: Retaliatory tariffs from China on US goods, following US tariffs, raise the risk of a broader trade conflict affecting global trade and corporate earnings.

n75e7e529f3.headline: HDFC Bank Hikes Lending Rates: EMIs to Rise as Home, Personal, and Auto Loans Get Costlier
n75e7e529f3.summary: HDFC Bank raised its marginal cost of funds based lending rate by up to 10 basis points across tenures, effective April 7, affecting new and existing floating-rate loans.
n75e7e529f3.why: HDFC Bank is one of India's largest private lenders, so changes to its lending rates affect borrowing costs and loan demand.

n4952ce81c4.headline: Energy and tech giants to meet Government over plans to power UK AI
n4952ce81c4.summary: The first meeting of the government's new AI Energy Council will take place on Tuesday, with energy and technology companies invited to discuss plans to power UK AI.
n4952ce81c4.why: Power supply is a key constraint on the build-out of data centres and AI computing, so energy policy directly affects technology investment.

nba39f4d136.headline: Calls mount for RBA to intervene with jumbo rate cut
nba39f4d136.summary: Calls are mounting for the Reserve Bank of Australia to intervene with a jumbo rate cut. Markets are betting the central bank will cut rates by 50 basis points at its next meeting.
nba39f4d136.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives borrowing costs, the Australian dollar and bond yields.

n9ab47a79e1.headline: Audi halts U.S. deliveries of new imports amid Trump's tariffs
n9ab47a79e1.summary: German carmaker Audi has suspended deliveries of vehicles that arrived at US ports after April 2, in response to a 25 per cent tariff imposed by Trump.
n9ab47a79e1.why: Audi is a premium car brand of the Volkswagen Group, and US sales of imported vehicles are sensitive to tariff costs and pricing.

n4333fcbd4c.headline: 'Uncertain times': recession fears cloud debate lead-up
n4333fcbd4c.summary: Party leaders are presenting themselves as the safest hands to steer the country through troubled times, with recession fears shaping the pre-election debate.
n4333fcbd4c.why: Election outcomes can shape fiscal policy, interest rates and business confidence, which matter to investors in Australian assets.

n95e2303e2b.headline: Trade war may reduce buyer pool in housing market due to reliance on rich multinational workers
n95e2303e2b.summary: Changes affecting rich multinational workers could have major implications for Ireland's already low housing market activity, according to TheJournal.ie. The trade war is cited as the source of the uncertainty.
n95e2303e2b.why: Ireland hosts many multinational headquarters, so shifts in their workforce affect local property demand and the economy.

ncdbbcf18d3.headline: Any negotiations will put M'sia's interests first, says Tengku Zafrul ahead of US trip for talks
ncdbbcf18d3.summary: Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Tengku Zafrul Abdul Aziz says any negotiations will put Malaysia's interests first, ahead of a trip to the United States for talks on US tariffs.
ncdbbcf18d3.why: Malaysia is an export-oriented economy, so US tariff outcomes directly affect its electronics and manufacturing trade.

n3a1317d22e.headline: Google Merchant Center Updates: Changes For Online Sellers
n3a1317d22e.summary: Google Merchant Center is rolling out new rules affecting pricing and listings for online sellers, with changes arriving on April 8 and July 1.
n3a1317d22e.why: Google Merchant Center feeds product data into Google Shopping, so rule changes affect how online retailers reach shoppers and their sales.

nd3d7882324.headline: Taiwan activates $15 billion stock stabilisation fund after precipitous falls
nd3d7882324.summary: Taiwan authorised activation of its $15 billion stock stabilisation fund on Tuesday to prop up the market after two days of sharp falls following U.S. President Donald Trump's tariff moves.
nd3d7882324.why: Taiwan's stock stabilisation fund is a state-backed reserve used to support the domestic equity market during periods of sharp decline. Taiwan's market is heavily weighted toward technology exporters, so its moves matter for global semiconductor supply chains.
nd3d7882324.why_moved: Two days of sharp falls followed U.S. tariff announcements by President Trump, prompting authorities to activate the fund to support prices.

ned7fabcae3.headline: Ontario takes bite out of Premier Doug Ford’s promised US procurement ban
ned7fabcae3.summary: Ontario's ban on US contractors will not apply to those with more than 250 Canadian workers, narrowing the procurement ban that Premier Doug Ford had promised.
ned7fabcae3.why: Government procurement rules determine which firms can bid on public contracts, a significant market for construction and services companies. Ontario is Canada's most populous province and largest economy.

n46cd9f51e7.headline: Dutch mortgage applications surge as interest rates rise
n46cd9f51e7.summary: Dutch mortgage advisors had their busiest month in nearly three years in March, according to HDN, as clients rushed to lock in mortgages before further rate increases. Refinancing was especially strong.
n46cd9f51e7.why: Mortgage demand reflects household borrowing and the housing market, and is sensitive to interest rate moves set by lenders and central banks.

nc516f3e833.headline: Whiskey and dairy being left out of EU counter-tariffs ‘welcome’, Dail hears
nc516f3e833.summary: Irish whiskey and dairy have been left out of EU counter-tariffs, a move described as welcome in the Dáil, Ireland's parliament.
nc516f3e833.why: Ireland's whiskey and dairy exports are significant to its economy and are exposed to transatlantic tariff measures.

n2a7eae7748.headline: Roundup: U.S. stocks close mixed in choppy trade
n2a7eae7748.summary: US stocks ended mixed on Monday in a roller-coaster session as investor anxiety over a potential economic slowdown and persistent inflation remained elevated.
n2a7eae7748.why: US equities, measured by the S&P 500, are the main global benchmark for risk appetite. Growth and inflation concerns feed into Federal Reserve policy expectations.
n2a7eae7748.why_moved: Investor anxiety over a potential economic slowdown and persistent inflation kept volatility elevated. The input does not give index levels.

n0f9af43585.headline: Trump threatens China with 50% additional tariff, doubling total levies beyond product value - OrissaPOST
n0f9af43585.summary: President Trump threatened China with an additional 50% tariff, which would take total levies above the value of products, and said China must withdraw its 34% increase.
n0f9af43585.why: Tariffs on China affect global supply chains, import costs and earnings for multinational companies, and they shape trade-war risk premia across markets.

source.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

sources.name: Odisha News, Odisha Latest news, Odisha Daily - OrissaPOST

n0f9af43585.why_moved: Trump's threat of an additional 50% tariff on China, which would raise total levies above product values, escalates the trade dispute between the two countries.

nf94cc1f9e8.headline: Sensex jumps 1100 points, Nifty 50 above 22,500; why did Indian stock market skyrocket today? Explained with 5 reasons | Stock Market News
nf94cc1f9e8.summary: The Nifty 50 opened higher at 22,446 and touched an intraday high of 22,697 during Tuesday's session on Dalal Street, with the Sensex up about 1,100 points.
nf94cc1f9e8.why: The Sensex and Nifty 50 are India's benchmark indices, tracking the largest listed companies and foreign and domestic investor sentiment.
nf94cc1f9e8.why_moved: The index rose sharply in Tuesday's session, with the Nifty 50 moving above 22,500, though the input does not detail the specific causes.

n444e98b65f.headline: Indonesia Rupiah, Stocks Slump on Tariff Shocks After Extended Break
n444e98b65f.summary: The rupiah fell to a lifetime low and Jakarta stocks were set for their worst session since September 2011 after an extended break.
n444e98b65f.why: The Jakarta Composite Index tracks Indonesia's largest listed companies, and the rupiah's level affects import costs and foreign investor returns.
n444e98b65f.why_moved: Tariff shocks after an extended market break drove the rupiah to a lifetime low and sent Jakarta stocks to their worst session since 2011.

nf9a5f69d5c.headline: Carney, Eby meet in Victoria with softwood lumber duties a focal point
nf9a5f69d5c.summary: British Columbia Premier David Eby said he had a productive discussion with Prime Minister Mark Carney on Monday, focusing on a Team Canada approach to US attacks on the softwood lumber industry.
nf9a5f69d5c.why: Softwood lumber is a major Canadian export, and US duties on it directly affect forestry firms and British Columbia's economy.

n8da6fe5177.headline: Chinese billionaire in B.C. says she wants to buy Hudson’s Bay  | Globalnews.ca
n8da6fe5177.summary: A Chinese billionaire based in British Columbia says she wants to buy dozens of Hudson's Bay locations after the retailer's collapse.
n8da6fe5177.why: Hudson's Bay is a major Canadian department store chain whose collapse left its locations available for sale. A buyer could reshape Canadian retail real estate and store operations.

n9812332e76.headline: After Monday bloodbath, markets rebound in early trade; Sensex zooms over 1,000 points
n9812332e76.summary: Indian stock markets recovered strongly, with the Sensex rising over 1,000 points amid global market stabilization.
n9812332e76.why: The Indian stock market is a key emerging market indicator, and its movement reflects investor confidence in regional economic prospects.

n0d2f076b64.headline: iPhone Prices Set to Surge as Trump’s Tariffs Hit: Apple Stores See Rush in India
n0d2f076b64.summary: Tariffs are expected to increase iPhone prices, prompting consumers in India to buy ahead of cost hikes.
n0d2f076b64.why: Apple is a major technology company heavily reliant on China, and tariffs can influence product pricing and sales.

nc1472c8b45.headline: AMANAT calls for keeping the current agricultural tax system
nc1472c8b45.summary: The AMANAT party faction in Kazakhstan's Mazhilis opposes lowering the mandatory VAT registration threshold to 15 million tenge. The article also addresses the agricultural tax system.
nc1472c8b45.why: VAT registration thresholds determine which businesses must collect value-added tax, affecting small firms and tax revenue in Kazakhstan's economy.

n4828c8659c.summary: The average cash selling rate of the dollar in Ukraine fell by 10 kopiyky to 41.20 hryvnias. The euro rate dropped 30 kopiyky to 45.50 hryvnias.
n4828c8659c.why: The hryvnia's exchange rate against major currencies affects import prices, inflation and businesses with foreign-currency exposure in Ukraine.

n1dc64162a5.headline: Dollar price drops at Egyptian banks (latest update)
n1dc64162a5.summary: The dollar's exchange rate against the Egyptian pound fell by about 5 piasters in trading on Tuesday, April 8, 2025. Banks showed the decline in live rate tracking.
n1dc64162a5.why: The Egyptian pound's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and foreign investment flows into Egypt's economy.

na80df99a6a.headline: Senegal: What Is Holding Back the Drop in Gasoline Prices?
na80df99a6a.summary: Senegalese motorists continue to pay full price for gasoline even as the global oil market slides toward low prices and the barrel falls below $60. The liter of super remains firm.
na80df99a6a.why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil prices, and retail fuel costs in importing countries like Senegal depend on crude prices and local pricing rules.
